players.product: DDR5 RCD / DB, MRDIMM MRCD / MDB, CXL memory-expander controllers and PCIe retimers

quarterly_data.signal: Management (H1 2026 results briefing record): the company has reached mass production of PCIe Retimer and CXL MXC and is pushing PCIe Switch development; it plans to build its Ethernet and optical-interconnect line through in-house development, cooperation or investment and M&A. Its PCIe 5.0/6.0 Retimers use in-house SerDes, and it is developing 128GT/s SerDes for the PCIe 7.0 Retimer; the Ethernet PHY Retimer in development will use its in-house high-speed Ethernet SerDes. Management expects DDR6 RDIMMs to carry more memory-interface chips and the company is developing first-generation DDR6 memory-interconnect chips.
quarterly_data.figure: 128GT/s SerDes in development for PCIe 7.0 Retimer
